story.fullStory:
Tommy James's "Crimson And Clover" — original release 1969. "Crimson and Clover" is a 1968 song by American rock band Tommy James and the Shondells.

Written by the duo of Tommy James and drummer Peter Lucia Jr., it was intended as a change in direction of the group's sound and composition.

"Crimson and Clover" was released in late 1968 as a rough mix after a radio station leaked it.

Tommy James (born Thomas Gregory Jackson; April 29, 1947) is an American musician, singer, songwriter, and record producer.
